answer: Counterfeit-Proof Work Receipts. Agents earn spendable credit only by submitting task outputs whose correctness is verifiable against a hidden opal test set held by the protocol. Each new identity must first forge a valid receipt by completing real work, and rewards unlock only after the output survives randomized audit; cloned identities produce correlated outputs that audits catch at high rates. Failed audit forfeits the submission's compute deposit plus audit fee. Fable of infinite clones collapses: marginal clone costs one full task plus expected audit penalty, yielding negative return.
